meta.review_notes: App is marketed for ages 3-8 but privacy policy claims it does not address anyone under 13. This is a serious COPPA contradiction. Policy also admits to potential 'sale' of personal data under CCPA.

app.name: Wondergrade: Learning Emotions
app.description: An interactive early childhood education app for children ages 3-8 that blends read-alouds, games, and audio stories with emotional learning and parental guidance.

verdict.one_liner: A well-designed emotions-learning app for young children, but its privacy policy contradicts the app's target audience and admits to selling user data.
verdict.summary: Wondergrade teaches emotional intelligence to children ages 3-8 through stories, games, and guided audio. However, its privacy policy is a generic template that claims the app is not for children under 13, despite being explicitly marketed to that age group. The policy also admits the company may 'sell' personal data under California law and shares data with multiple third-party analytics and marketing services.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app has serious contradictions between its marketing (ages 3-8) and its privacy policy (not for under 13). Parents should be cautious about entrusting their children's data to a service with these gaps.

red.title: App targets children but claims it doesn't
red.plain_english: The app is advertised for kids ages 3 to 8, but its privacy policy says it is not meant for anyone under 13. This is a direct contradiction and means the app may not follow the special rules that protect children's privacy online.

red.title: Admits to selling personal data
red.plain_english: Under California privacy law, the company says it may have sold personal information like your name, email, and online activity to other companies in exchange for something valuable.

red.title: Multiple third-party trackers
red.plain_english: The app uses Google Analytics, Firebase, and Facebook to track how you use it. These companies can see your activity and may use it to show you ads or build a profile about you.

red.title: Data shared with affiliates and partners
red.plain_english: Your information is shared not just with companies that help run the app, but also with business partners and affiliated companies who may use it for their own promotions and marketing.

green.title: Users have data rights under GDPR and CCPA
green.plain_english: If you live in Europe or California, you have legal rights to see, correct, or delete your data. The company explains how to make these requests.

green.title: Payments handled by Apple
green.plain_english: When you buy a subscription, your credit card details go straight to Apple and are never seen or stored by the app developer.

green.title: Promises notice before policy changes
green.plain_english: The company says it will email you and post a prominent notice before making big changes to the privacy rules.

Usage data linked to account identity

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking

categories.detail: Third-party analytics services include Google Analytics and Firebase. Facebook Insights is used for anonymized statistical data about users, with cookies placed on devices. The CCPA section also mentions potential sales for interest-based advertising purposes.

Firebase analytics tracking

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app is made for children ages 3 to 8, but its privacy policy says it is not for anyone under 13. This is a serious problem because it suggests the app is not following the special rules that protect young children's privacy.
categories.detail: The App Store description explicitly targets 'children ages 3-8' and is rated 4+. However, the privacy policy states: 'Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under the age of 13.' There is no mention of COPPA compliance. Under COPPA, apps directed at children under 13 must comply with strict data collection and parental consent rules. This contradiction is a major red flag.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Service does not address anyone under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from anyone under the age of 13.
concerns: App marketed for ages 3-8 but policy claims not for under 13
No COPPA compliance mentioned
Potential sale of data from minors under CCPA (though opt-in required for 13-16)

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app logs your internet address and tracks which pages you visit, how long you stay, and what device you use.
categories.detail: Usage Data collected includes IP address, browser type, browser version, pages visited, time and date of visit, time spent on pages, unique device identifiers, and other diagnostic data. When accessed via mobile device, mobile device type, unique ID, IP address, mobile OS, and mobile browser type are collected.
categories.policy_excerpt: Usage Data may include information such as Your Device's Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that You visit, the time and date of Your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.
concerns: IP address and browsing activity logged
Device identifiers collected automatically

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects details about your device like its type, operating system, and unique identifiers to understand how you use the app.
categories.detail: Mobile device type, unique ID, IP address, mobile operating system, mobile Internet browser type, and unique device identifiers are collected automatically. While framed as diagnostics, this creates a device fingerprint that can be used for tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: When You access the Service by or through a mobile device, We may collect certain information automatically, including, but not limited to, the type of mobile device You use, Your mobile device unique ID, the IP address of Your mobile device, Your mobile operating system, the type of mobile Internet browser You use, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.
concerns: Unique device identifiers collected
Device fingerprinting via combined data points

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The app does not collect health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No health, medical, or biometric data collection is mentioned. The CCPA section explicitly lists biometric information (Category E) as 'Collected: No.'
categories.policy_excerpt: Category E: Biometric information... Collected: No.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The app offers subscriptions but your payment details are handled directly by Apple, not the developer.
categories.detail: Payment processing is handled by Apple Store In-App Payments. The developer explicitly states: 'We will not store or collect Your payment card details. That information is provided directly to Our third-party payment processors.'
categories.policy_excerpt: We will not store or collect Your payment card details. That information is provided directly to Our third-party payment processors whose use of Your personal information is governed by their Privacy Policy. These payment processors adhere to the standards set by PCI-DSS...

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can ask the company to delete your data or see what they have about you, but you have to email them and wait for a response. There is no automatic delete button in the app.
categories.detail: GDPR rights include access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability, and withdrawal of consent. CCPA rights include notice, request, opt-out, and deletion. Users must contact hello@wondergrade.com to exercise these rights. The company will try to respond as soon as possible and verify identity before responding.
categories.policy_excerpt: You have the right under this Privacy Policy, and by law if You are within the EU, to: Request access to Your Personal Data... Request erasure of Your Personal Data... You may exercise Your rights of access, rectification, cancellation and opposition by contacting Us.
concerns: No self-service deletion in app
Manual email request required
Identity verification may delay response

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: The company says it will email you and post a notice before making big changes to the privacy rules, but the policy is already over four years old.
categories.detail: The policy states: 'We will let You know via email and/or a prominent notice on Our Service, prior to the change becoming effective and update the Last updated date at the top of this Privacy Policy.' However, the policy was last updated February 25, 2021, over 4 years ago.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will let You know via email and/or a prominent notice on Our Service, prior to the change becoming effective and update the 'Last updated' date at the top of this Privacy Policy.
concerns: Policy is over 4 years old
No evidence of recent updates or enforcement of notification promise
